title: Portsmouth Square renovation
verdict_line: Bridge removal opposition exists but hasn't reached the official record the decision-maker actually counts.
stakes: Whether the historic pedestrian bridge at Portsmouth Square gets removed as part of a $73M renovation. The SF Recreation and Park Commission decides; the District 3 supervisor's office fields constituent input.
record_gap: Organized opposition exists: 56 forum comments, 10 testimony speakers, and in-language organizing by CCBA and merchants. District 3 Supervisor reports receiving no such communication in the official record.
do_next: Submit written comment to Rec & Park Commission Secretary; one distinct submitter, in their own words.
Register CCBA speakers for general public comment; bring in-language speakers to testify on the record.
Ask District 3 supervisor's office to formally log the bridge-removal opposition in the official record.
